about: Tower Defense structures, built from real cells. Everything sits on a grid of `grid` cells; `size` is in grid squares (a tower is 2x2, so 6x6 cells). cells = rows of the key below. range in cells, rate in seconds, dmg per hit. fromWave = appears in the dock when that wave starts. Read by js/game/towers.js. group trap = lies flat on the road (no cells, never blocks it; art = the tile picture only); pierce = ignores armour and shields; minRange = cannot hit closer than this.

palisade.name: Timber Wall
palisade.desc: Cheap, and a line of it steers enemies. It burns.

wall.name: Stone Wall
wall.desc: Drag to build a line. Enemies must walk round it, so a long maze keeps them under your towers. Fire does not touch it.

ironwall.name: Iron Wall
ironwall.desc: The one to put in front of trolls and golems, which smash their way through.

spikes.name: Spike Trap
spikes.desc: Lies flat on the road and stabs whatever walks over it. It does not block the way. Armour blunts it.

tar.name: Tar Pit
tar.desc: Lies flat on the road. Whatever wades through slows to half and burns twice as hard for a while: put a Fire Pit next to it.

archer.name: Archers
archer.desc: Quick arrows at one enemy, on the ground or in the air. Timber: it can burn.

arbalest.name: Arbalest
arbalest.desc: Heavy bolts that punch straight through armour and shields. Ground and air.

ballista.name: Ballista
ballista.desc: One slow, huge bolt from far away. Double damage to bosses.

cannon.name: Bombard
cannon.desc: Stone shot that bursts among a crowd. Ground only.

flame.name: Fire Pit
flame.desc: Burns everything close by and sets it alight. Short reach, and it can light the grass.

frost.name: Frost Spire
frost.desc: Chills everything near it to a crawl. Put it at a corner of your maze.

venom.name: Venom Spitter
venom.desc: Spits poison that eats through armour and wards, damage every second. Up to five doses stack on one enemy.

sun.name: Sun Shrine
sun.desc: A pulse of sunlight: triple damage to the dead, breaks every ward, and drags burrowing Delvers up where towers can see them.

arcane.name: Obelisk
arcane.desc: Three homing darts of light that never miss.

trebuchet.name: Trebuchet
trebuchet.desc: Hurls huge stones across half the map. Big splash, slow to reload, and it cannot hit anything close to it. Ground only.

mint.name: Mint
mint.desc: Pays gold after every wave. Upgrades pay more.

mender.name: Mender
mender.desc: Rebuilds damaged structures around it, one stone at a time.
